hero.headline: Your voice, typed instantly. Privately.
hero.subheadline: Flow seamlessly across all your Mac apps with AI auto-editing, custom vocabularies, and snippet libraries. Local, private speech-to-text.
hero.note: macOS 15+ · Apple Silicon · 50 free transcriptions included
hero.live_transcription_text: "Hey team, just summarizing the meeting. We are going to prioritize the new dashboard for Q3 to boost user engagement."
hero.subtitle_p1: Write emails, documents, and messages just by speaking. Private, fast, and stays entirely on your Mac.
hero.thought_1: The future of writing isn't typing...
hero.thought_2: It's speaking naturally and having it appear exactly where you need it.
hero.thought_3: Spoken words fly away, written ones remain.

demo.headline: Press a key. Speak. Done.
demo.step_01_desc: Hold Fn in the app you’re writing in. Verba is ready when you are.
demo.step_02_desc: Speak in your own rhythm, in your own language. No special commands to learn.
demo.step_03_desc: Release Fn. Verba transcribes, optionally cleans up, and pastes your words where you’re writing.

privacy_section.headline: Private by Design.
privacy_section.subheadline: Your audio stays on your Mac. Always.
privacy_section.local_storage_desc: Recordings and transcripts are saved locally on your Mac.
privacy_section.no_account_desc: Download, launch, speak. Zero signup, zero login, zero tracking.
privacy_section.offline_desc: No internet needed. Everything runs on your Apple Silicon hardware.
privacy_section.quote: Your voice is yours. We never hear it.
privacy_section.quote_extension: All speech recognition and text cleanup happen locally on your Mac.

features.headline: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.transcription_desc: Press Fn, speak, text appears in any app.
features.languages_desc: Speak naturally in 99 languages, with automatic language detection.
features.push_to_talk_desc: Hold Fn for quick takes. Lock mode for hands-free recording.
features.history_desc: Every transcription saved locally with timing and duration.
features.metal_desc: Fast, responsive dictation built for Apple Silicon. Ready to keep up with your thoughts.
features.cleanup_desc: On-device AI removes filler words and fixes grammar.
features.telemetry_desc: No usage tracking, analytics, or behavioural profiles.
features.subheadline: Powerful features wrapped in a simple experience.

dictionary.headline: Your words. Spelled your way.
dictionary.description: Names, project terms, phrases you use every day. Save them in Verba’s native Dictionary, and your local replacement rules keep them written your way.
dictionary.learning_description: Correct a word after dictating, and Verba can suggest saving the change for next time. Accept it or ignore it—you approve every rule, and can turn correction learning off anytime.
dictionary.example_caption: An illustrative rule. Your Dictionary stays on your Mac.
dictionary.compatibility_note: When enabled, correction learning briefly observes edits to text Verba just pasted in a supported field. It requires Accessibility access; support varies by app and field.

pricing.headline: Pay once. Own it forever.
pricing.subheadline: No subscriptions. No recurring fees. No surprises.
pricing.trial_desc: 50 transcriptions included — no credit card, no time limit, no signup
pricing.paid_desc: Unlimited transcriptions, 3 devices, all future updates

cleanup.headline: AI Text Cleanup
cleanup.subheadline: Optional cleanup, fine-tuned for dictation. Remove the hesitations and tidy the punctuation, while keeping your meaning.
cleanup.before_text: um can you send the updated proposal by friday and uh include the new timeline
cleanup.after_text: Can you send the updated proposal by Friday and include the new timeline?
cleanup.feature_fillers: Removes filler words (um, uh, like, basically)
cleanup.feature_lists: Formats spoken lists into actual bullet points
cleanup.feature_styles: Style modes: Standard, Formal, Casual, Excited
cleanup.note: Optional setup download. After that, cleanup runs on your Mac.
cleanup.before_annotated: <filler>um</filler> can you send the updated proposal by friday and <filler>uh</filler> include the new timeline
cleanup.original_image_alt: Original email transcription in Verba: greeting, message and sign-off in one paragraph.
cleanup.cleaned_image_alt: The same email after Verba cleanup: greeting, message and sign-off separated into paragraphs.

cta_block.headline: Start speaking. Stop typing.
cta_block.note: macOS 15+ · Apple Silicon required · No account needed

footer.tagline: A private speech-to-text app for Mac. Your voice never leaves your device.

redesign.hero_description: Speak wherever you write. Verba transcribes and cleans up your words <local>locally on your Mac</local>. <private>Your audio and transcripts never go to a server.</private>
redesign.promise_local: All voice processing on your Mac
redesign.demo_text: Let’s set aside some time tomorrow to explore the new idea. Bring a sketch, a question, or just a fresh perspective. See you there!
redesign.privacy_description: Your ideas don’t need a round trip to someone else’s server. From the first word to the final edit, your Mac does the work.
redesign.diagram_alt: Your voice is processed into text entirely inside your Mac.
redesign.diagram_caption: A short journey. A private one.
redesign.audio_description: Audio and transcripts stay on your device. Dictation and cleanup happen locally, without sending your words to a cloud service.
redesign.tracking_description: No usage tracking, no analytics, no behavioural profiles. What you say—and how often you say it—is your business.
redesign.offline_description: Once set up, speech recognition and text cleanup work without an internet connection. On a flight, off the grid, at your desk.
redesign.connection_note: An internet connection is needed for setup downloads, updates, and license activation and periodic validation. Your audio and transcripts are never part of those requests.
redesign.workflow_eyebrow: Less between you and your words.
redesign.workflow_description: Stay in the app you’re using. Verba works quietly in the background, ready when your next thought arrives.
redesign.cleanup_title:
Still your words.
Just a little clearer.
redesign.closing_eyebrow: A little more flow. A lot more privacy.
redesign.video_title: Say it where you need it.
redesign.video_description: Draft an email, give an AI assistant a detailed brief, or get an idea into a document. Speak into the text field you’re already using, in Mac apps and on the web. Less typing, less switching between windows, more time for the thought itself.
redesign.dictionary_alt: Verba Dictionary settings with word replacement rules and individual switches.
redesign.dictionary_caption: The Dictionary in Verba. Your rules stay on your Mac.
redesign.video_accessible_label: Silent demo: dictate a report prompt into ChatGPT. Verba records, processes the speech locally, and inserts the finished prompt without submitting it.
redesign.dictionary_suggestion_alt: Verba asks whether to remember the correction from Christian to Cristian, with Ignore and Accept options.
